chunks: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Yahya al-Attar (ra) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Isa from his father from Safwan b. Yahya from al-Is b. al-Qasim. He said: I said to al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad (as):

A hadith is attributed to your father, and it says: 'The Messenger of Allah (s) was never satiated with wheat bread.' Is this correct? So, he said: No. The Messenger of Allah (s) never ate wheat bread at all, and he was never satiated with barley bread either.
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about eating wheat and barley bread?
ai.summary: In this hadith, al-Is b. al-Qasim asks Imam al-Sadiq (as) about a narration attributed to his father Imam al-Baqir (as) that the Prophet (s) was never filled with wheat bread. The Imam corrects this, stating that the reality was even more austere: the Prophet (s) never ate wheat bread at all, and he was never filled with barley bread either. This illustrates the extreme simplicity of the Prophet's lifestyle and his detachment from worldly comforts.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Yahya al-`Attar (ra) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. `Isa from his father from Safwan b. Yahya from al-`Is b. al-Qasim. He said: I said to al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as):

A hadith is attributed to your father, and it says: “The Messenger of Allah (s) was never filled (satiated) with wheat bread.” Is this correct? So, he said: No. The Messenger of Allah (s) never ate from wheat bread, and he was never filled with barley bread.
